G: guard only; no module writes G yet
L: guard only; only the core's preload congestion writes L yet
N: guard only; no module writes N yet
V: guard only; the family engine's circulation clamp [.25, 1.9] is deliberately not adopted
W: guard only; no module writes W yet
k: guard only; no module writes K yet

KD-S1: REVISE CORE: D with memory produces lactate; RR from W plus a saturating metabolic drive
KD-S2: ADOPT CORE DIRECTION: HR from R plus one common sympathetic drive plus modulators
KD-S3: RESOLVED, not changed in P2C: physiology reads the unrounded state; display and gating read Observation v2
KD-S4: REVISE CORE: one smooth, saturating preload curve; no clamp

KD-S1: lactate and respiratory rate (approved revision, P2C-1): the core accumulates an oxygen-delivery debt D (tau provisional), produces lactate from D and clears it with its own memory, and reads RR as ventilation (W) plus a saturating metabolic drive anchored to arrival, so clearing lactate never causes bradypnoea; the family engine sets both instantly from circulation, with an RR floor of 14 in this family
TBD: tau_D, D->lactate gain, lactate clearance, metabolic drive gain, RR bounds
KD-S2: heart rate (adopted direction, P2C-2): the core reads sinus rate as the intrinsic rate plus the chronotropic response to one common sympathetic drive, blunted by beta-blockade; the drive answers to the pressure deficit, the oxygen-delivery debt D, hypoxaemia and hypoglycaemia, rises at once and decays with its own memory, and no disease module writes it, so hemostasis lowers the rate only through recovered pressure and repaid debt; the family engine sets HR instantly from circulation and subtracts 20 bpm x hemostasis_relief from the displayed HR (a module writing an observable, which §8.1 rules out)
TBD: pressure/output deficit and D gains, hypoxaemia and hypoglycaemia gains and thresholds, sympathetic decay time
KD-S3: consciousness at the 80 mmHg threshold: the family engine compares the rounded SBP (80), the core the raw value (79.9)
Observation v2 (Phase 1): thresholds on raw state or on the displayed value
KD-S4: volume, pressure and refill (approved revision, P2C-3): the core reads output from one smooth, saturating preload curve (V -> effective preload -> stroke volume -> output -> pressure), concave everywhere, with arrival placed on it by a case position (provisional default 0.5, where its slope equals the family engine's linear gain) and output lowered by tone above arrival; the family engine is linear in volume and clamps circulation to [.25, 1.9] (+625 mL-eq). So pressure, refill and the rate differ wherever V leaves arrival: a little below it (the curve is steeper there), more above it (the curve saturates), and past the clamp the core's V keeps rising while its output barely moves
TBD: curve form and scale, arrival position, P sensitivity, afterload sensitivity, congestion knee and gain

afterload_sensitivity: how much tone above arrival lowers output, 1 / (1 + a (T - 1)): TBD (KD-S4)
arrival_preload_fraction: where arrival sits on the preload curve when the case does not declare it (0 empty, 1 plateau): TBD (KD-S4)
congestion_per_excess_preload: L per minute at full excess and no pump reserve: TBD (KD-S4)
congestion_preload_knee: position on the preload curve above which excess preload congests a pump without reserve: TBD (KD-S4)
debt_clearance_tau_min: tau_D_recovery: TBD (KD-S1); 60 min is not approved
hr_per_sympathetic_drive: family_engine._surface: hr + (circulation - 1) * 25, read here as bpm per unit of sympathetic drive
hypoglycaemia_threshold_mg_dl: glucose below which it drives the rate: TBD (KD-S2)
hypoxaemia_threshold_spo2: SpO2 below which hypoxaemia drives the rate: TBD (KD-S2)
lactate_drive_threshold_mmol_l: lactate above which acidaemia drives breathing: TBD (KD-S1)
lactate_per_output_deficit: family_engine._diagnostic: lactate + (circulation - 1) * 2, reached here as the steady state of D and of lactate kinetics; the D -> lactate production gain it implies is provisional (KD-S1)
preload_curve_scale_ml: scale of the saturating preload curve 1 - exp(-x / scale): TBD (KD-S4). Its value keeps, at the default arrival position 0.5, the family engine's slope at arrival: 300 mL per red-cell unit / 0.36 circulation per unit (family_engine.TRANSFUSION note; _minute)
pressure_levels: family_engine._PRESSURE_LEVELS, without the DC1 anchoring or the recovery margin, which belong to the observation layer
rr_max: safety bound on RR, not physiology: TBD (KD-S1)
rr_metabolic_max: largest metabolic addition to RR (saturation): TBD (KD-S1)
rr_per_lactate: metabolic drive -> RR gain at the threshold: TBD (KD-S1); the value is the legacy GI RR gain 15 per circulation unit / lactate 2 per unit
rr_ventilatory_floor: RR below which the arrival RR is never read as metabolic: TBD (KD-S1)
sympathetic_decay_tau_min: sympathetic decay time: TBD (KD-S2); the drive rises at once
sympathetic_per_debt: oxygen-delivery debt (D / tau_D) -> sympathetic drive gain: TBD (KD-S2)
sympathetic_per_hypoglycaemia_mg_dl: drive per mg/dL below the threshold: TBD (KD-S2)
sympathetic_per_hypoxaemia_point: drive per SpO2 point below the threshold: TBD (KD-S2)
sympathetic_per_pressure_deficit: MAP/output deficit -> sympathetic drive gain: TBD (KD-S2)
